headline: War Day 521: Frontlines Shift as Casualties Fluctuate
war_summary: Three hours on, the blood‑soaked Weathered Expanse has cooled in the latest hour — Colonial and Warden losses dropping to roughly 110 and 240 per hour — yet the two‑hour Warden trend now accelerates, and six‑hour turnover remains the highest on the map with sixty‑four base changes. Callahans Passage still bleeds, but the Colonial hourly rate has risen to 306 while the Warden rate has slipped to 268, both two‑hour trends accelerating. Palantine Berm’s ferocity has eased; the last two hours show 227 Colonial and 186 Warden dead, the one‑hour rates falling to 61 and 34, though the two‑hour curves turn upward again. Stlican Shelf presents a mixed picture: Colonial casualties have fallen to 20 per hour (cooling) while Warden losses climb to 69 (accelerating), with both two‑hour trends gaining speed. Nevish Line’s Colonial surge has faded to 37 per hour cooling, Warden losses also cooling at 105, yet the two‑hour trends for both sides now accelerate. Stonecradle’s casualties have risen from single digits to the mid‑teens per hour, both sides cooling in the hour but accelerating over two hours. Fresh skirmishes appear at Callums Cape, Kuura Strand, Mooring County and Oarbreaker, though none yet yield significant base turnover.
